protocol: Keep the first three original comparisons. If they all fail the acceptance gate, judge three unseen candidates against the original document at rank five. Select them from the existing held-out rank-union or supervised shortlist on the same dense top 100. Keep the original suffix if any prefix comparison passes. All arms use six comparisons, both orders, and at most one replacement. The shared inference run reuses unchanged, identical pairs across arms. Qrels are used only for scoring and diagnostics.
